title: "Public cohorts survival"
author: "Asier Antoranz"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

Scores the nevus-like programme in the Leeds and GSE98394 primary melanoma cohorts and tests its association with overall survival.

**Inputs:** Expression and clinical data in `paper_data/Public_cohorts/Leeds` and `GSE98394`, with Xenium signatures, gene mappings and aliases in `paper_data/Public_cohorts/inputs`.

**Outputs:** Processed GSE98394 expression and metadata in `data/`; sample scores, Cox models, Kaplan–Meier estimates and supplementary-table inputs in `results/`; survival plots in `figures/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Set these root folders before running the notebook.
data_root <- 'path_to_input'
output_root <- 'path_to_output'

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = FALSE)

```

```{r load_libraries}

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

outdir <- file.path(output_root, 'Public_cohorts')
input_dir <- file.path(data_root, 'Public_cohorts', 'inputs')
data_dir <- file.path(data_root, 'Public_cohorts')
intermediate_dir <- file.path(outdir, 'data')
result_dir <- file.path(outdir, 'results')
figure_dir <- file.path(outdir, 'figures')
for (path in c(outdir, intermediate_dir, result_dir, figure_dir)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
future::plan('sequential')
library(survival)
source_dir <- file.path(data_dir, 'GSE98394')
leeds_dir <- file.path(data_dir, 'Leeds')

```

## Prepare GSE98394

```{r prepare_gse98394}

# Read GEO sample metadata and map Ensembl IDs to gene symbols.
lines <- readLines(gzfile(file.path(source_dir, 'GSE98394_matrix.txt.gz')))
lines <- lines[startsWith(lines, '!Sample_')]
records <- lapply(lines, function(x) scan(text = x, what = character(), sep = '\t', quote = '"', quiet = TRUE))
ids <- records[[which(vapply(records, function(x) x[1] == '!Sample_geo_accession', logical(1))) ]][-1]
metadata <- data.frame(sample_id = ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (record in records) {
  if (record[1] == '!Sample_characteristics_ch1') {
    for (j in seq_along(ids)) {
      value <- record[j + 1]
      if (!grepl(': ', value, fixed = TRUE)) next
      key <- sub(': .*$', '', value)
      metadata[j, key] <- sub('^[^:]+: ', '', value)
    }
  } else if (record[1] %in% c('!Sample_title', '!Sample_source_name_ch1')) {
    metadata[[substring(record[1], 9)]] <- record[-1]
  }
}
metadata$expression_id <- sub('.*\\(([^)]+)\\).*', '\\1', metadata$title)
metadata$group <- ifelse(metadata$tissue == 'primary melanoma', 'primary', 'nevus')
metadata$breslow <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(metadata[['primary tumor thickness (breslow’s depth)']]))
metadata$OS_time_months <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(metadata[['time to death/last followup, months']]))
metadata$OS_event <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(metadata[['survival status (1=dead, 0=alive)']]))
metadata$stage <- metadata[['tumor stage (ajcc classification)']]
raw <- fread(file.path(source_dir, 'GSE98394_expression.txt.gz'))
mapping <- fread(file.path(input_dir, 'GENCODE_v36_gene_mapping.tsv'))
genes <- mapping$gene_name[match(raw[[1]], mapping$gene_id)]
expression <- as.matrix(raw[, metadata$expression_id, with = FALSE])
colnames(expression) <- metadata$sample_id
keep <- !is.na(genes) & nzchar(genes)
expression <- rowsum(expression[keep, , drop = FALSE], genes[keep], reorder = TRUE) / as.numeric(table(genes[keep]))
expression <- expression[order(rownames(expression), method = 'radix'), , drop = FALSE]
dir.create(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'gse98394'), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fwrite(data.frame(gene = rownames(expression), expression, check.names = FALSE), file.path(intermediate_dir, 'gse98394/GSE98394_expression_gene.tsv.gz'), sep = '\t', na = 'NA')
fwrite(metadata, file.path(intermediate_dir, 'gse98394/GSE98394_metadata.tsv'), sep = '\t', na = 'NA')

```

## Nevus-like scores in primary melanoma cohorts

```{r load_melanoma_signatures}

signatures <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, 'clean_xenium_signatures.rds'))
objects <- list()

```

```{r import_leeds_cohort}

clinical <- fread(file.path(leeds_dir, 'LMCclinical.txt'))
raw <- fread(file.path(leeds_dir, 'daslgxLMC.txt'))
annotation <- fread(file.path(leeds_dir, 'daslht12v4genelist.txt'))
clinical <- clinical[match(raw$egaid, egaid)]
index <- match(toupper(names(raw)[-1]), toupper(annotation$probe))
genes <- annotation$gene[index]
genes[which(genes == 'BHLHB3' & annotation$entrez_gene_id[index] == 79365)] <- 'BHLHE41'
keep <- !is.na(genes) & nzchar(genes)
expression <- t(as.matrix(raw[, -1]))
storage.mode(expression) <- 'double'
colnames(expression) <- raw$egaid
expression <- rowsum(expression[keep, , drop = FALSE], genes[keep], reorder = TRUE) / as.numeric(table(genes[keep]))
meta <- data.table(sample_id = clinical$egaid, OS = as.numeric(clinical$diedv44), OS_days = as.numeric(clinical$ostimev44) * 365.25, breslow = as.numeric(clinical$breslow), stage = as.numeric(clinical$ajccstage))
objects$Leeds <- list(expr = expression, meta = meta)
rm(raw, expression)

```

```{r import_gse_cohort}

raw <- fread(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'gse98394/GSE98394_expression_gene.tsv.gz'))
expression <- as.matrix(raw[, -1])
rownames(expression) <- raw[[1]]
meta <- fread(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'gse98394/GSE98394_metadata.tsv'), na.strings = c('', 'NA', 'n.a.', 'Unknown'))
if ('H4C3' %in% rownames(expression) && !'HIST1H4C' %in% rownames(expression)) rownames(expression)[rownames(expression) == 'H4C3'] <- 'HIST1H4C'
aliases <- fread(file.path(input_dir, 'signature_gene_aliases.tsv'))
for (gene in unique(unlist(signatures))) {
    candidates <- intersect(na.omit(aliases$ALIAS[aliases$SYMBOL == gene]), rownames(expression))
    if (!gene %in% rownames(expression) && length(candidates)) 
        rownames(expression)[rownames(expression) %in% candidates] <- gene
}
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(expression))) expression <- rowsum(expression, rownames(expression), reorder = TRUE) / as.numeric(table(rownames(expression)))
expression <- expression[, meta$group == 'primary', drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[group == 'primary']
variation <- apply(expression, 1, sd)
expression <- expression[is.finite(variation) & variation > 1e-8, , drop = FALSE]
meta[, `:=`(OS = as.numeric(OS_event), OS_days = as.numeric(OS_time_months) * 365.25 / 12, stage_original = stage)]
meta[, stage := as.numeric(factor(sub('[abcABC]$', '', stage), levels = c('I', 'II', 'III')))]
objects$GSE98394 <- list(expr = expression, meta = meta)
rm(raw, expression)

```

```{r score_nevus_programme}

scores <- list()
for (cohort in names(objects)) {
    object <- objects[[cohort]]
    expression <- object$expr
    sets <- lapply(signatures, intersect, y = rownames(expression))
    seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Matrix::Matrix(pmax(expression, 0), sparse = TRUE), min.cells = 0, min.features = 0)
    LayerData(seurat, assay = "RNA", layer = "data") <- Matrix::Matrix(expression, sparse = TRUE)
    seurat <- AddModuleScore(seurat, features = sets, name = "final", ctrl = 5, nbin = 10, seed = 20260901, search = FALSE)
    score <- seurat@meta.data[[paste0("final", match("nevus_like_senescence", names(signatures)))]]
    data <- copy(object$meta)
    data[, `:=`(dataset = cohort, nevus_score = score, OS_eligible = OS %in% 0:1 & is.finite(OS_days) & OS_days > 
        0)]
    scores[[cohort]] <- data[, .(dataset, sample_id, nevus_score, OS, OS_days, OS_eligible, breslow, stage)]
}
scores <- rbindlist(scores)
fwrite(scores, file.path(result_dir, "sample_scores.tsv"), sep = "\t", na = "NA")

```

## Nevus-like scores and overall survival

```{r prepare_survival_followup}

samples <- scores[OS_eligible == TRUE]
samples[, years := OS_days / 365.25]

```

```{r fit_continuous_cox}

models <- list()
for (cohort in c("Leeds", "GSE98394")) {
    for (adjustment in c("unadjusted", "stage", "thickness")) {
        data <- copy(samples[dataset == cohort])
        if (adjustment == "stage") 
            data <- data[is.finite(stage)]
        if (adjustment == "thickness") 
            data <- data[is.finite(breslow) & breslow > 0]
        data[, `:=`(z, as.numeric(scale(nevus_score)))]
        formula <- switch(adjustment, unadjusted = Surv(years, OS) ~ z, stage = Surv(years, OS) ~ z + strata(stage), 
            thickness = Surv(years, OS) ~ z + log2(breslow))
        fit <- coxph(formula, data = data, ties = "efron")
        model <- summary(fit)
        models[[paste(cohort, adjustment)]] <- data.table(dataset = cohort, adjustment = adjustment, n = nrow(data), 
            deaths = sum(data$OS), HR = model$conf.int["z", 1], lower = model$conf.int["z", 3], upper = model$conf.int["z", 
                4], p = model$coefficients["z", 5])
    }
}
models <- rbindlist(models)

```

```{r fit_survival_groups}

assignments <- list()
curves <- list()
risks <- list()
tests <- list()
for (cohort in c("Leeds", "GSE98394")) {
    data <- copy(samples[dataset == cohort])
    cutoff <- as.numeric(quantile(data$nevus_score, 0.1, type = 7))
    data[, `:=`(group = ifelse(nevus_score > cutoff, "High", "Low"), cutoff = cutoff)]
    test <- survdiff(Surv(years, OS) ~ group, data = data, rho = 0)
    tests[[cohort]] <- data.table(dataset = cohort, cutoff = cutoff, low_n = sum(data$group == "Low"), high_n = sum(data$group == 
        "High"), low_deaths = sum(data[group == "Low"]$OS), high_deaths = sum(data[group == "High"]$OS), logrank_p = pchisq(test$chisq, 
        1, lower.tail = FALSE), max_followup = max(data$years))
    assignments[[cohort]] <- data
    ticks <- if (cohort == "Leeds") 
        seq(0, 15, 3)
    else seq(0, 20, 5)
    for (label in c("High", "Low")) {
        group_data <- data[group == label]
        fit <- survfit(Surv(years, OS) ~ 1, data = group_data)
        curves[[paste(cohort, label)]] <- data.table(dataset = cohort, group = label, time = fit$time, surv = fit$surv, 
            lower = fit$lower, upper = fit$upper, n_censor = fit$n.censor, n_risk = fit$n.risk, n_event = fit$n.event)
        risks[[paste(cohort, label)]] <- data.table(dataset = cohort, group = label, time = ticks, n_risk = sapply(ticks, 
            function(t) sum(group_data$years >= t)))
    }
}

```

```{r export_survival_results}

outputs <- list(continuous_cox = models, assignments = rbindlist(assignments), curves = rbindlist(curves), risk = rbindlist(risks), summary = rbindlist(tests))
for (name in names(outputs)) fwrite(outputs[[name]], file.path(result_dir, paste0(name, ".tsv")), sep = "\t", na = "NA")

```

## Survival plots and supplementary data

```{r plots_tables}

# Continuous-score hazard ratios.
models$adjustment <- factor(models$adjustment, levels = c('thickness', 'stage', 'unadjusted'))
p <- ggplot(models, aes(HR, adjustment, colour = dataset)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = 'grey60') +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lower, xend = upper, yend = adjustment)) + geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~dataset) + scale_x_log10() + theme_classic() +
  labs(x = 'Hazard ratio per SD of nevus-like score (95% CI)', y = NULL)
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, 'Figure_5FG_continuous_cox.pdf'), p, width = 8, height = 3)

# Kaplan–Meier estimates and pointwise confidence intervals.
curves <- outputs$curves
starts <- unique(curves[, .(dataset, group)])
starts[, `:=`(time = 0, surv = 1, lower = 1, upper = 1)]
plot_data <- rbindlist(list(starts, curves), fill = TRUE)
setorder(plot_data, dataset, group, time)
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(time, surv, colour = group)) + geom_step() +
  geom_step(aes(y = lower), linetype = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_step(aes(y = upper), linetype = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~dataset, scales = 'free_x') + theme_classic() +
  labs(x = 'Years', y = 'Overall survival', colour = 'Nevus-like score')
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, 'Figure_5HI_overall_survival.pdf'), p, width = 8, height = 3.5)

# Patient-level supplementary table inputs.
metadata <- objects$GSE98394$meta
for (cohort in c('Leeds', 'GSE98394')) {
  tab <- scores[dataset == cohort & OS_eligible == TRUE]
  if (cohort == 'GSE98394') tab[, stage_original := metadata$stage_original[match(sample_id, metadata$sample_id)]]
  fwrite(tab, file.path(result_dir, paste0('Table_7_', cohort, '.tsv')), sep = '\t', na = 'NA')
}

```
